definition: Synthetic patient identity, inspired by MIMIC subject_id.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE patients(subject_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, gender TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(gender IN ('F','M')))

definition: Distinct hospital stays per patient with actual admission/discharge milestones.
row_grain: One row per hospital admission, identified by hadm_id.
declared_checks: CHECK(edregtime IS NULL OR edregtime<=admittime); CHECK(dischtime IS NULL OR discharge_authorized_at<=dischtime)
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE admissions(hadm_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, subject_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(subject_id), edregtime TEXT, admittime TEXT NOT NULL, discharge_authorized_at TEXT, dischtime TEXT, CHECK(edregtime IS NULL OR edregtime<=admittime), CHECK(dischtime IS NULL OR discharge_authorized_at<=dischtime))

definition: Optional additional information for the SAME patient identified by patients.subject_id, in the SAME identifier namespace. A matching subject_id denotes the same actual patient. No FK is declared; this identity relationship is explicitly documented. Authored split-storage extension.
row_grain: At most one supplementary profile per patient.
logical_relationships: subject_id -> patients(subject_id): Documented identifier relationship; no declared SQL foreign key
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE patient_profile(subject_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, profile_verified_at TEXT NOT NULL, preferred_language TEXT NOT NULL)

definition: Optional additional information for the SAME hospital stay identified by admissions.hadm_id. A matching hadm_id denotes the same actual admission. Only a subset of admissions has a signed summary. Authored split-storage extension.
row_grain: At most one signed-summary record per hospital admission.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE admission_detail(hadm_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES admissions(hadm_id), discharge_summary_signed_at TEXT NOT NULL, summary_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(summary_status='SIGNED'))

definition: Authored laboratory request; multiple measurements can fulfill it. subject_id identifies the patient even when hadm_id is NULL for a request outside an admission.
row_grain: One authored laboratory request for one patient, optionally associated with an admission.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE lab_order(order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, subject_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(subject_id), hadm_id INTEGER REFERENCES admissions(hadm_id), specimen_received_at TEXT, results_verified_at TEXT)

definition: One medication prescription, including its stop time. Dispensing is recorded separately in pharmacy.
row_grain: One medication prescription; dispensing records and dose records have their own identities.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE medication_order(order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, hadm_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES admissions(hadm_id), medication TEXT NOT NULL, stopped_at TEXT)

definition: Distinct procedure order; repeated execution episodes belong to one order.
row_grain: One row per procedure order; multiple execution episodes may belong to it.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE procedure_order(order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, hadm_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES admissions(hadm_id), procedure_name TEXT NOT NULL, preparation_completed_at TEXT)

definition: Repeated order actions, inspired by provider order transaction semantics; not a copy of poe.
row_grain: One row per order-action occurrence, including repeated reviews.
foreign_keys: procedure_order_id -> procedure_order.order_id; medication_order_id -> medication_order.order_id; lab_order_id -> lab_order.order_id
declared_checks: CHECK((lab_order_id IS NOT NULL)+(medication_order_id IS NOT NULL)+(procedure_order_id IS NOT NULL)=1)
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE order_history(history_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, lab_order_id INTEGER REFERENCES lab_order(order_id), medication_order_id INTEGER REFERENCES medication_order(order_id), procedure_order_id INTEGER REFERENCES procedure_order(order_id), action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(action IN ('ENTERED','REVIEWED','CANCELLED')), occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK((lab_order_id IS NOT NULL)+(medication_order_id IS NOT NULL)+(procedure_order_id IS NOT NULL)=1))

definition: Measurement occurrences with separately charted and available-result times, inspired by MIMIC labevents.
row_grain: One row per measurement occurrence; repeated measurements have different labevent_id values.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE labevents(labevent_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES lab_order(order_id), itemid INTEGER NOT NULL, charttime TEXT NOT NULL, storetime TEXT NOT NULL, valuenum REAL, valueuom TEXT, CHECK(charttime<=storetime))

definition: Medication administration or omission occurrences, inspired by MIMIC emar.
row_grain: One administration or omission record referring to one pharmacy dispensing record.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE emar(emar_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, pharmacy_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pharmacy(pharmacy_id), charttime TEXT NOT NULL, event_txt TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_txt IN ('Administered','Not Given')), storetime TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK(charttime<=storetime))

definition: Authored hospital-level procedure execution episode; not the MIMIC ICU procedureevents table.
row_grain: One hospital-level procedure execution episode, not an ICU stay.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE procedure_episode(procedureevent_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES procedure_order(order_id), starttime TEXT NOT NULL, endtime TEXT, storetime TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK(endtime IS NULL OR starttime<=endtime))

definition: One distinct dispensing record for a medication prescription; repeated dispensing records can fulfill the same prescription.
row_grain: One dispensing record for one medication prescription; a prescription may have zero or multiple dispensing records.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE pharmacy(pharmacy_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES medication_order(order_id), dispensed_at TEXT NOT NULL)
